team_name: Final Governance Team 3 — Audit & Command Compliance

patterns.title: Strict Append-Only Non-Destructive Learning & Per-Agent/Per-Team Isolation Compliance
patterns.standard_playbook: Audit all 11 teams and 32 agents to prove zero duplicated keys, zero erased rows, strict individual case_key isolation per agent_id, manager-curated team patterns, and faithful execution of Founder prompts and rules.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Block DELETE/UPDATE on learning tables via PostgreSQL immutability trigger (ERRCODE 42501); evolve lessons strictly by appending new records linked via supersedes_id.
